parse_manifest_file: create a ManifestParser from a .ini manifest file to extract build configuration and dependency metadata
create_fetcher_for_dependency: create a fetcher object from a ManifestParser to download source code via git, archive, or system packages
create_builder_for_project: create a builder object from a ManifestParser to compile a project using cmake, make, autoconf, or cargo
evaluate_conditional_sections: use ManifestContext to evaluate platform-specific conditional sections in a manifest file for cross-platform builds
generate_context_for_projects: create a ContextGenerator to manage per-project build contexts with different os, distro, and test settings
